LevelData.name: Layer 1 level stream (one level) + $FF filler
summary: Layer-1 object stream for one level, followed by $FF padding to the end of the bank (about 2.7KB free).
Format: 5-byte primary header, then 3-byte objects (Y/screen, X/object#, settings) until a $FF byte; see LevelData loader at $0585FF.
Header here: 3 screens, level mode 00, tileset 0, sprite GFX 3, music 0, 300 second timer, no scroll restriction.
Objects: Y = byte1 bits 0-4 (0-26), X = byte2 low nibble, object# = byte2 high nibble | byte1 bits 5-6 << 4, byte1 bit 7 = next screen.
Quirk: extended object 00 (screen exit) is 4 bytes; the extra byte is the destination. Everything after the $FF terminator is unused filler.
